purpose: Use tiny pulse observations and content-addressed encrypted fragments to reduce origin/API pressure while measuring prediction error over time.

futureEncryptedFragmentTransport.rule: One tiny pulse manifest advertises opaque fragment hashes. Unchanged fragment hash means no payload fetch. Only changed encrypted fragments are fetched.
futureEncryptedFragmentTransport.fullSnapshotFallback: allowed only after residual/escalation or explicit user refresh

rateLimitBehavior.originThrottling: prefer cached shell + LOCAL VFS; prediction never substitutes missing observation
